components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one next action on a screen: Next, Start, Return to questions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:0 22px; border:0; border-radius:10px; background:var(--accent, #1e6a56); color:var(--accent-ink, #ffffff); font:600 17px/1 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent, #1e6a56); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:0.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Back, Start again, Open the screen again: everything that is not the next step.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:0 22px; border:0; border-radius:10px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #16201c); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--line, #d6ddd9); font:600 17px/1 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent, #1e6a56); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Answer Tile
components.description: A whole-tile radio answer; selected tiles take the Scrub Green border on Scrub Tint.
components.css: .ds-tiles { display:grid; gap:8px; font:400 18px/1.55 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; color:var(--ink, #16201c); } .ds-tile { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:52px; padding:10px 14px; border:1.5px solid var(--line, #d6ddd9); border-radius:10px; background:var(--surface, #ffffff); cursor:pointer; } .ds-tile:has(input:checked) { border-color:var(--accent, #1e6a56); background:var(--accent-soft, #e1eee8); } .ds-tile input { width:20px; height:20px; margin:0; accent-color:var(--accent, #1e6a56); } .ds-tile:has(input:focus-visible) { outline:3px solid var(--accent, #1e6a56); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text Box
components.description: Open answers; Field Line border so an empty box is visible.
components.html: <label class="ds-q" for="ds-t">What did you do, and what happened?</label><textarea id="ds-t" class="ds-textbox"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-q { display:block; margin-bottom:10px; font:600 19px/1.35 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; color:var(--ink, #16201c); } .ds-textbox { width:100%; min-height:88px; padding:12px 14px; border:1.5px solid var(--field-line, #7f8a85); border-radius:10px; background:var(--surface, #ffffff); color:var(--ink, #16201c); font:400 18px/1.55 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; resize:vertical; } .ds-textbox:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--accent, #1e6a56); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Task Card
components.description: The task prompt and its Open button on Scrub Tint.
components.html: Before sorting starts, you notice an additional instrument on the input tray. Show what you would do next.
components.css: .ds-task { display:grid; gap:14px; justify-items:start; padding:18px 20px; border-radius:12px; background:var(--accent-soft, #e1eee8); color:var(--ink, #16201c); } .ds-task p { margin:0; font:700 21px/1.35 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-task-btn { min-height:60px; padding:0 22px; border:0; border-radius:10px; background:var(--accent, #1e6a56); color:var(--accent-ink, #ffffff); font:600 19px/1 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; }

components.name: Info Card
components.description: White card with a hairline border: consent bullets, tasks intro.
components.html:
• Estimated time: about 10 minutes.
  • The clickable screen is not connected to a robot.
components.css: .ds-card { padding:18px 20px; border:1px solid var(--line, #d6ddd9); border-radius:12px; background:var(--surface, #ffffff); color:var(--ink, #16201c); font:400 18px/1.55 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card ul { margin:0; padding-left:20px; display:grid; gap:6px; }

components.name: Progress Header
components.description: Step name, step count and a 6px bar that fills by steps finished.
components.html: Task 1 of 4Step 4 of 9
components.css: .ds-progress { display:grid; gap:8px; } .ds-progress-row { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font:400 15px/1.55 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; color:var(--ink-2, #4b5752); } .ds-progress-row b { font:600 13px/1.55 Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:0.04em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--accent, #1e6a56); } .ds-bar { height:6px; border-radius:3px; background:var(--line, #d6ddd9); overflow:hidden; } .ds-bar i { display:block; height:100%; background:var(--accent, #1e6a56); }

narrative.overview:
The page is a respectful conversation with people who know instrument sets better than its authors do. It asks one thing at a time, explains exactly what happens to the answers, and invites criticism without ever selling IRIS. Nothing on screen competes with the question being asked: one green carries every next step, and everything else is ink on a pale, near-white ground.

Density is comfortable and generous, never cramped: participants may be on a shared hospital PC in a short break or on their own phone, so targets are large (52px and up), text is set in a face built for legibility, and each screen is a single column that reads top to bottom. The controls are sturdy and plain: flat surfaces, clear borders, no decoration.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, Scrub Green, used only for the next action, progress and selection.
Flat throughout: no shadows; separation comes from borders and tinted surfaces.
Archivo for headings, questions and buttons; Atkinson Hyperlegible for everything people read.
Big, square-ish rounded targets (10px corners, 52px minimum height).
Light and dark themes from the same roles.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Scrub Green marks only the next action, progress and the current selection. A second green button on the same screen means one of them should be quiet.

rules.name: The Prototype Is Not Ours Rule
rules.body: The embedded operator screen keeps its own colors. The study's chrome around it never borrows them, and never restyles the prototype.

rules.name: The Readable Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing anyone needs to read is smaller than 15px; inputs stay at 18px so phones do not zoom in.

rules.name: The Flat Form Rule
rules.body: Separate with a border or a tint, never a shadow. The prototype's own raised controls are its business.

dos: **Do** keep one Scrub Green action per screen state; make every other button quiet.
**Do** keep controls at least 52px tall (44px for the text link) and text at 15px or larger.
**Do** separate with Hairline borders and Scrub Tint, not shadows.
**Do** use Field Line, not Hairline, for text-box borders.
**Do** define every new color as a role on `:root` with a dark-mode value.
donts: **Don't** add shadows, gradients or decoration to study controls.
**Don't** restyle or recolor the embedded prototype.
**Don't** use the uppercase label style above a heading; it is reserved for the progress header and the task bar.
**Don't** let the page read like marketing for IRIS: no hero imagery, badges or promotional color.
